articles.title: Global Market: China's securities regulator to meet market participants as state-backed investors step in to support stocks
articles.content: China's securities regulator will meet market participants to discuss equity market stabilization. State-backed investors are also buying shares to help arrest the decline. The China Securities Regulatory Commission seeks industry feedback on potential policy measures. Chinese equities faced intense pressure last week amid liquidity and geopolitical concerns. Authorities are deploying state capital to support equity prices and restore confidence.

articles.title: South Korea's share market losses deepen as leveraged AI bets take a heavy toll
articles.content: South Korean shares experienced a significant decline, triggering market-wide trading curbs. Investors are unwinding AI-linked trades, extending a sharp correction in the KOSPI index. This selloff highlights growing investor anxiety over leveraged bets on AI chipmakers. Markets also reacted to escalating Gulf conflict and rising oil prices. Major tech earnings are expected to further test investor confidence in the AI sector.

articles.title: Global Market: Chinese state-backed funds step in with fresh equity purchases after market sell-off
articles.content: Chinese state-backed investors China Reform Holdings and China Chengtong have announced fresh equity purchases to stabilise markets after a sharp sell-off. The firms deployed billions of yuan to support share buybacks, SOE stocks and ETFs, as China’s STAR Market Index slumped 25% from its July peak.

articles.title: Rs 91,000 crore wipeout: What spooked HDFC Bank, Axis Bank and Kotak investors even as credit growth picked up?
articles.content: Nearly Rs 91,000 crore was wiped off the market value of HDFC Bank, Axis Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank as stronger credit growth failed to offset concerns over shrinking net interest margins, weaker CASA deposits and leadership uncertainty. ICICI Bank bucked the trend, supported by resilient profitability and balanced loan growth.

articles.title: SBI Funds Management IPO listing tomorrow: GMP signals 18% listing gain
articles.content: SBI Funds Management is set to debut on the NSE and BSE on July 21, with the grey market indicating an around 18% listing premium over the IPO price. articles.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank shares fall over 3% despite Q1 profit growth. Analysts weigh in
articles.content: Kotak Mahindra Bank shares fell after reporting a strong profit increase for the first quarter. Net profit rose 26% year-on-year, and net interest income also saw growth. Asset quality improved from the previous year, though key ratios weakened sequentially. Brokerages provided varied ratings, with some reiterating buy recommendations and others maintaining add ratings. Analysts cited controlled slippages and credit costs as positive factors supporting the bank's performance.

articles.title: PNB shares jump 6% as Q1 profit soars 214%, beats Street estimates. What next?
articles.content: Punjab National Bank shares rose sharply on Monday after the PSU lender reported a 214% YoY jump in Q1FY27 net profit, beating Street estimates. articles.title: Natco Pharma shares surge 5% after US FDA's tentative nod Olaparib tablets
articles.content: Natco Pharma shares rose sharply on Monday after the U.S. FDA granted tentative approval for its generic Olaparib tablets, a bioequivalent version of AstraZeneca’s Lynparza. The drug addresses a $1.4-billion U.S. market opportunity. The company will manufacture the product, while Alembic Pharmaceuticals will handle its U.S. commercialisation.

articles.title: Why is market falling today? Sensex slumps 600 points, Nifty tests 24,200. 6 factors behind the selloff
articles.content: Indian stock markets traded lower on Monday, impacted by Iran-US tensions.  Sensex and Nifty experienced significant declines, reflecting investor concerns over rising oil prices.  Tech Mahindra and Bharti Airtel shares saw gains, while Axis and HDFC Bank shares dropped.  Broader markets also traded with marginal losses, with private banks leading the decline.  Despite the overall dip, market breadth showed a slightly positive trend with more advances than declines.

articles.title: Ashish Kacholia, Mukul Agrawal, other ace investors sell smallcaps again in Q1. Should you worry?
articles.content: Ace investors Ashish Kacholia, Mukul Agrawal, Dolly Khanna, and Madhusudan Kela were net sellers of small-cap stocks in Q1 FY27, booking profits after a strong market rally and trimming weaker holdings. articles.title: ICICI Bank shares rise 3% after Q1 results. Why Bernstein and 4 other brokerages see up to 32% upside
articles.content: ICICI Bank shares rose 3% after the lender reported strong Q1FY27 results, with net profit growing 15.9% and net interest income rising 12.7%, driven by healthy loan growth and improving asset quality. Following the earnings, Bernstein upgraded the stock to 'Outperform' with a target price of Rs 1,800, citing superior growth, resilient margins and strong profitability prospects.
